required_nodes.rationale: Real Ed25519 authenticated-root evidence and an exact fresh operator-bound registry produce bounded currentness evidence.
Future revocation remains ineffective before its timestamp and exact revocation fails at and after it without changing key trust.
Canonical principal time and bounded snapshot freshness independently fail closed.
Corrupt, substituted, wrong-version, and duplicate-entry registries cannot establish currentness.
Exact authenticated-evidence cross-binding is mandatory and serialized callers cannot construct verified currentness.
Absence in a stale snapshot proves nothing and the implementation exposes no allocation, authority, signing, issuance, mutation, or remote-update surface.
